stats.quarks_aria.texto: Quarks: {n}. Open the shop in your profile

lab.subtitulo.texto: Experiment with your elements: build molecules, solve riddles and see it all in augmented reality.

adivina.subtitulo.texto: Which element is this object? The Sun, a gold doubloon, a drop of water…

adivina.vacio.texto: You don't know any elements with an object yet. Do the first lesson on the path.

foto.subtitulo.texto: Stand next to Marie Curie and your molecules in augmented reality and take a photo.

personajes.explicacion.texto: You meet each scientist when you reach their unit on the path.

personajes.bloqueado_texto.texto: Keep going along the path: they are waiting for you in a later unit.

intro.0.texto.texto: I'll be with you while you discover chemistry. If you don't look at me, I might vanish for a while…

intro.camino.texto.texto: You start with just hydrogen. Each lesson introduces a new element.

intro.racha.texto.texto: Keep your streak, complete quests and climb leagues with your class or the whole world. Free and offline.

leccion.protones.texto: How many protons does an atom of {nombre} have?

leccion.protones_explica.texto: The atomic number of {nombre} is {z}, and the atomic number is exactly the number of protons in the nucleus: {z}.

leccion.quien.texto: Which element am I talking about?

leccion.forma_texto.texto: Tap the atoms you need (careful, some are extra).

camino.racha_peligro.texto: 🔥 Your {n}-day streak is waiting: do a lesson today

camino.racha_empieza.texto: Do a lesson to start your streak

camino.dice.leccion.texto: Let me introduce {nombre}! You'll be surprised.

camino.dice.laboratorio.texto: To the lab! Put the cards together to build {formula}.

camino.dice.adivina.texto: Can you recognise each element by its object?

camino.dice.repaso.texto: Reviewing is the trick to not forgetting. Let's go!

camino.dice.cofre.texto: A chest! Open it, you've earned it.

camino.que.leccion.texto: History, uses and what makes it unique; then a few questions.

camino.que.laboratorio.texto: The table opens with the right cards (and a decoy or two).

camino.que.adivina.texto: 3D objects: guess which element they are.

camino.que.repaso.texto: Mixed questions about everything so far.

camino.que.cofre.texto: Quarks for the shop: streak protectors and more.

misiones.todas.texto: Complete all three for {n} extra quarks.

mision.perfectas.texto: Do a lesson with no mistakes

liga.clase_sin.texto: Join a class (in your profile) to compete with classmates.

liga.sin_red.texto: Offline: the league updates when you are back online.

liga.mundial_texto.texto: Compete every week with people all over the world. The top 7 move up a league.

liga.privacidad.texto: Optional and anonymous: you get a fun nickname and only your XP is shown. No names or personal data.

liga.anterior.sube.texto: You came {puesto} and move up to {liga}!

liga.anterior.baja.texto: You came {puesto} and drop to {liga}. Go for it!

liga.sin_grupo.texto: Earn XP this week to join a group.

liga.reglas.texto: Moving up: top {sube} (green). Moving down: bottom {baja} (red).

perfil.calendario_aria.texto: Calendar of the last weeks: {n}-day streak

perfil.protectores.texto: 🧊 Streak protectors: {n}. Used automatically if you miss a day.

perfil.avatar_mas.texto: Meet more scientists on the path to unlock their avatars.

tienda.texto.texto: Quarks: {n}. Earn them with lessons, quests and chests.

tienda.gratis.texto: Everything here is paid with in-game quarks: the app is 100% free, no real-money purchases.

tienda.protector.texto.texto: If you miss a day, your streak isn't lost. Max 2.

tienda.impulso.texto.texto: For 15 minutes, everything you do gives double XP.

cofre.texto.texto: Spend them in the shop in your profile.

racha.texto.texto: Come back tomorrow to keep it growing.

ficha.porque.texto: Why this one and not another?

tabla.bloqueado_camino.texto: You'll meet it in unit {unidad} of the path.

insignia.fotografo.descripcion.texto: Take a photo with a character

profe.liga_texto.texto: XP this week (Monday to Sunday). It is for motivation, not for grading.

profe.liga_vacia.texto: Nobody has earned XP this week yet.

foto.pista.texto: Move with one finger, pinch to resize and twist with two fingers.

foto.pista_ra.texto: Tap the floor to place them. For the photo, use your phone's screenshot.

foto.modo_camara_texto.texto: Character and molecule over what you see; selfies too.

foto.modo_ra_texto.texto: Place them on the floor at figurine size and walk around them.

leccion.electrones.texto: How many electrons does a neutral atom of {nombre} have?

leccion.electrones_explica.texto: A neutral atom has as many electrons as protons. {nombre} has {z} protons, so it has {z} electrons.

leccion.neutrones.texto: How many neutrons does the most common isotope of {nombre} ({simbolo}-{a}) have?

leccion.neutrones_explica.texto: Neutrons = mass number − atomic number. In {simbolo}-{a}: {a} − {z} = {neutrones}.
